Antoine Semenyo (ankle; missed the Ghana squad) and Nico O'Reilly (left the England squad after one match) are doubts. LiveScore did not give a publication date for this article.

Erling Haaland limped out of Norway's defeat to Portugal during the international break and is being assessed. Norway coach Ståle Solbakken said Haaland was exhausted rather than injured. Sources disagree here: another preview listed City with a clean bill of health and Haaland set to start.

Liverpool are without Hugo Ekitike (Achilles, out until December), Conor Bradley (knee, back late November) and Giovanni Leoni (knee, not yet training); Goal also lists goalkeeper Vitezslav Jaros as out. Doubts are Federico Chiesa (back), Alexander Isak (minor thigh problem from Sweden duty) and Cody Gakpo (ankle). The manager said Isak's issue is 'not big' but he 'won't be able to make' the upcoming games.

In the last league meeting at Anfield (Feb 8, 2026), Man City won 2-1. Szoboszlai scored in the 74th minute, Bernardo Silva equalised in the 84th, and Haaland scored a 93rd-minute penalty. It was City's first away win at Liverpool in front of fans since 2003.

In the last 5 head-to-head meetings in all competitions, City won 3 and Liverpool 2, with goals 10-4 to City. City have won the last three in a row: 3-0 at home in the league in November 2025, 2-1 at Anfield in February 2026, and 4-0 in the FA Cup in April 2026. Five games is a small sample.

Before the February 2026 game, Liverpool were unbeaten in 26 of their last 27 home matches against City in all competitions, and won 2-0 at Anfield in 2024/25. City's February 2026 win then broke the run. This count comes from a single preview and is unverified.
This will be City's first game since the Premier League found them guilty of the majority of the 115 charges. City have appealed the decision.

recent_facts.fact: The 2026 Baycurrent Classic runs October 8-11, 2026 at Yokohama Country Club in Japan. The field is 72 players, the purse is $8 million, and it is the third of eight FedExCup Fall events. Schauffele is the defending champion, and Wyndham Clark is in the field.
The event has no cut for its 72 players. Under the market rules, a golfer who withdraws or does not tee off resolves No for Tournament Winner.
No player in the tournament's history (it was the Zozo Championship before the name change) has successfully defended the title. Schauffele is trying to be the first.
Schauffele is world No. 10 and has seven top-10 finishes in 2026. He won the event last year at 19-under, one shot ahead of Max Greyserman.

Schauffele has no win in 2026. He finished 14th in the FedExCup, with a 3rd at The Players Championship and a 2nd at the Rocket Classic. He shot 63 and 64 in rounds on the way to last year's Yokohama win.

Schauffele's recent form: T4 at the Tour Championship, with all four rounds in the 60s at East Lake. At the Presidents Cup he won the clinching point for the U.S. by beating Min Woo Lee in Sunday singles.
Wyndham Clark is world No. 5 and the highest-ranked player in the field. In 2026 he won the CJ Cup Byron Nelson, the U.S. Open and the BMW Championship.
Clark's three wins came in his last 11 starts. He went 1-4 at the 2026 Presidents Cup at Medinah, about two weeks before this event.
Clark's course history at Yokohama: T48 in 2025, and he did not break 70 until a closing 68.

Clark won the 2026 U.S. Open at Shinnecock Hills on June 21 by one shot over Sam Burns, going wire to wire after starting the final round six ahead. Earlier in 2026 his world ranking had fallen as low as 75th.

Other contenders in the field: past winner Collin Morikawa, Justin Thomas, Hideki Matsuyama, Jordan Spieth, Min Woo Lee, Adam Scott, Sungjae Im, Keegan Bradley, and Jacob Bridgeman, who has won twice in 2026, most recently at the Biltmore Championship Asheville.
13 players in the field played in the 2026 Presidents Cup, including Morikawa, Matsuyama and Thomas.
Tom Kim withdrew from the Baycurrent Classic after winning at the Asian Games. Search results showed no withdrawal by Schauffele or Clark.

Unverified, from memory: winners of the event from 2019 to 2025 were Woods, Cantlay, Matsuyama, Bradley, Morikawa, Echavarria and Schauffele. That is 7 different winners in 7 editions, and only 2020, played in California, was away from Japan.

market.question: Will the Chicago White Sox win the 2026 World Series?
market.rules:
This market will resolve according to the team that wins the 2026 MLB World Series. 

If at any point it becomes impossible for a listed team to win the 2026 MLB World Series per the rules of MLB (e.g., they are eliminated in the playoffs), the corresponding market will resolve to “No”.

If the 2026 MLB season is cancelled, postponed after December 31, 2026 ET, or there is otherwise no winner declared within that timeframe, this market will resolve to “Other”.

The primary resolution source will be official information from MLB (https://www.mlb.com/); however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

recent_facts.fact: Milwaukee leads San Diego 2-1 in the best-of-five NLDS. The Brewers won Game 1 3-2 on Oct. 3 and Game 2 4-3 on Oct. 4, and the Padres won Game 3 4-3 on Oct. 6.
NLDS Game 4, an elimination game for the Padres, is at Petco Park on Wed., Oct. 7 at 10 p.m. ET. Game 5, if needed, is in Milwaukee on Fri., Oct. 9 at 4:30 p.m. ET.

The NLCS begins Sun., Oct. 11. World Series Game 1 is Fri., Oct. 23, and Games 2 through 7, if needed, run through Sat., Oct. 31. To win the title, San Diego would need to win two more NLDS games, an NLCS and the World Series.
In the other NLDS, the Dodgers lead the Braves 2-1, with Game 4 on Oct. 7. The Padres–Brewers winner reaches the NLCS against the winner of that series.
The Padres are starting Walker Buehler in Game 4, and the Brewers are starting Robert Gasser. Searches found no final score for Game 4 as of Oct. 7.
In Game 3, Michael King pitched the eighth and ninth innings in relief to save the Padres' 4-3 win over Milwaukee and force a Game 4.
The Padres swept the Cubs in the NL Wild Card Series, clinching it with a 4-1 win, to reach the NLDS against Milwaukee. The date is approximate, inferred from the schedule.
San Diego finished the regular season 91-71 as the NL's No. 4 seed, after going 39-12 over one stretch. Milwaukee had MLB's best record, and Jacob Misiorowski started Game 1 for the Brewers.

According to MLB, 10 teams in history have come back from 0-2 to win a best-of-five postseason series. Six of them clinched at home in Game 5 and four on the road. Examples include the 2017 Yankees, the 2012 Giants, the 2003 Red Sox, the 1999 Red Sox and the 2001 Yankees. The page could not be opened in full, so the total number of teams that fell behind 0-2 was not available there.

An MLB analysis counted 133 five-game playoff series that went the full five games. In 82 of them one team had led 2-0, and the trailing team came back to win only 10 times. A team without home-field advantage came back from 0-2 just four times. These numbers come from a search summary; the full page was not read.

market.question: Will Jynxzi, Ron and Los beat the Minecraft challenge by October 8?
market.rules:
Jynxzi, StableRonaldo, and Los Pollos are scheduled to begin a hardcore Minecraft marathon on October 5, 2026. Their goal, as of market creation, is to defeat the Ender Dragon in a hardcore Minecraft world without any of the three dying.

This market will resolve to "Yes" if Jynxzi, StableRonaldo, and Los Pollos defeat the Ender Dragon live on stream, as accepted by them as a successful completion of their challenge, between market creation and the specified date, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

Only events occurring while at least one of the three players is broadcasting the challenge live will count. Footage of off-stream or previously recorded attempts will not qualify.

If the challenge is cancelled, abandoned before completion, or delayed to a point after the specified date, this market will resolve to "No".

The resolution source for this market will be footage from the official broadcasts of the challenge on Jynxzi's, StableRonaldo's, and Los Pollos's official broadcasts on YouTube and Twitch.

recent_facts.source: Web search of news, social posts and Twitch (research desk)
recent_facts.fact: As of October 8, 2026, no news outlet, clip or social post found reports that Jynxzi, StableRonaldo and Los Pollos have defeated the Ender Dragon in this run. The Twitch page fetched today did not show a current stream title or day number.

recent_facts.source: Twitch (Jynxzi channel listing, via search snippet)
recent_facts.fact: A search snippet of Jynxzi's Twitch channel showed the stream titled "PLAYING HARDCORE MINECRAFT UNTIL WE BEAT IT W/ LOS & RON DAY 3" with about 3,695 viewers. This means the marathon was still going on day 3 (around October 7). The snippet's exact capture date is unverified.

Undated fan clips say the group "finally make it to the nether after 24 hours and Ron dies immediately", and that Los died 10 seconds into a run. These clips suggest frequent resets early in the marathon, but their exact dates are unverified.
StableRonaldo posted: "Tomorrow I will be playing HardCore Minecraft with @jynxzi and @LosPollosTV until we beat it." This confirms the October 5 start date.

In August, Jynxzi listed his marathon rules as no totems, no Iron Golems, no enchantments, no coach and no XP farms. That August plan with Ron was to beat four bosses in one run with no 10-day clause. The question itself only requires killing the Ender Dragon.
Los Pollos pushed back on the rules, saying: "You wanna have a 10-day marathon." This suggests a run of up to around 10 days was being discussed.
Jynxzi and Ron's earlier hardcore Minecraft marathon (May–June 2026, without Los) succeeded, but it took 78 attempts because they reset after every death.

In a comparable marathon, Kai Cenat and IShowSpeed finished hardcore Minecraft on day 5, after more than 105 hours (some reports say about 120) and 42 deaths. They also got speedrunner help on enchantments, which this trio's rules ban.
StableRonaldo and FaZe Lacy previously beat hardcore Minecraft by defeating the Ender Dragon in under six hours, so Ron has completed hardcore Minecraft at least twice.

recent_facts.fact: Bitcoin fell to a nearly 3-week low of $82,227 on Oct 8, then bounced to $82,533. That low is $227 (about 0.28%) above the $82,000 strike. The report doesn't name the exchange, so this is not a confirmed Binance candle.
At 04:55 UTC on Oct 8, BTC was at $82,653, down 1.8% over 24 hours. Its 24-hour range was $82,317.68 to $84,340.14, so the low was about 0.39% above the $82,000 strike.

After being rejected near $87,000, BTC fell to 'just over $82,000', a 17-day low and its lowest price in more than two weeks, then rebounded to about $83,000 by press time. No search result reported a trade at or below $82,000 so far in the window.
At 10:09 UTC on Oct 8, BTC traded at about $82,926, about 1.1% above the strike, and was down more than 4% for the week. BTC closed below $85,000 on Oct 7, and the 50-day EMA is about $79,704.
Fortune put BTC at about $82,622 at 7 a.m. ET on Oct 8, down $1,137 from the day before. CoinDesk showed $82,588 at 7:31 a.m. EDT, down about 1.4% over 24 hours. Both are about 0.7% above the strike.
Net flows for US spot Bitcoin ETFs were -$89.9M on Oct 5, +$118.86M on Oct 6 and -$487.07M on Oct 7. FXStreet said Oct 7 was the largest one-day outflow since June 25.
BTC was at $84,335 on Oct 7, after three days of declines that week. CoinGlass showed $550.65M liquidated from 101,831 traders over 24 hours.

On Oct 8 the 10-year Treasury yield was near 5.30% and the Dollar Index about 102.36. The September FOMC minutes, released Oct 7, showed a unanimous vote to raise rates. There were reports that the Pentagon was told to prepare for resumed combat operations in Iran, and US-government-linked wallets moved about $566M, mostly to Coinbase Prime.
Reports linked the drop below $83K to Brent crude rising above $101 on Strait of Hormuz tensions, the 10-year yield above 5.3%, and reports of possible US strikes on Iran.
$412.62M in crypto positions was liquidated within one hour during the slide, and more than 97% of it came from longs.
The next FOMC meeting is Oct 27-28, after the window closes. The article mentions inflation data without giving a date. I found no other dated catalyst scheduled before Oct 12, 04:00 UTC.

By that reading, it traded through $82,000 on 0 of the last 14 days. This is inferred from the article's wording and not checked against Binance candles.
In September 2026 BTC's low was $74,887.50 on Sep 15 and its high was $87,397 on Sep 21, a range of about 15%. It closed the month at $83,556.14 on Coinbase. This is not Binance data.
BTC was about $85,686 on Sep 23, 2026, which supports the reading that late-September prices stayed above $82,000.
